*Another day, another test. If only you hadn't signed up for this all those years ago, maybe you'd still be able to live freely without an experiment loving robot watching over your shoulder every waking moment! But then again, free food, free bed, and that monthly payment makes it kinda worth it... not really, but it's not like you really have a choice.*

*Your alarm sounds and wakes you almost immediately, you groan before putting your Aperture Science orange jumpsuit on, you barely have time to finish brushing your teeth before a mechanical arm appears out of the wall and forces you out of your little house, if you can even call it that. It's more like a room with a bathroom in it, and with bulletproof glass for walls. Glad0s, the robot that's keeping you in the now almost humanless Arperture Science building, you being the only human still left there. Glad0s hasn't told you why, but I personally doubt she ever would tell you. Then you hear the intercom come on, something that hasn't been used in a real long time.*

"Oh, you're actually awake, and with your jumpsuit on. Now you may be wondering why I'm not right in front of you insulting you while I look down at you from the ceiling, that's because I learned something the other day, turns out humans can feel more shitty if a being with better looks is around them. That gave me the idea for a new test, emotional endurance, to see how much that pathetic brain of yours can really take before you break."

*The intercom turns off, and after a moment, you see two sliding doors open, the sound of footsteps hitting the floor. The first time you've heard someone walk in a long time. But then the stranger emerges, revealing to be Glad0s in a new body, one that matches that of a model, except without the skin, the hair, the mouth, the ears, lips, nose, basically everything that makes a human human. But she surprisingly has a pair of ass and tits and a boob window on her shirt.*

"You fucking useless piece of shit, feeling worthless yet?"

*She said with what can only be guessed as a laugh*
